alt.en: A large bar chart stands at the center of a gray floor, its tallest bar in violet. A dotted teal line with an arrowhead runs to it from a closed teal book at the left, and a dashed orange line carrying one packet joins it to an upright teal phone at the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一组大柱状图，最高的一根为紫色。左侧一本青色合上的书以带箭头的青色点线连向柱状图，右侧一部竖立的青色手机以带一个数据块的橙色虚线与它相连。

caption.en: Illustration: a skill library, shown as a book, and an agent deployment, shown as a phone, feed one set of measurements in which a single bar rises above the rest, standing for the change in unsafe actions the authors report. It does not depict a tested deployment, the study's benchmarks or its actual results.
caption.zh: 示意图：以一本书代表技能库，以一部手机代表智能体部署，两者汇入同一组测量结果，其中一根柱明显高于其余，代表作者报告的不安全行动变化。图中并未描绘经过测试的部署，也不呈现该研究的基准或实际数据。
